about: Public bodies Wikidata records in each Crown Dependency and Overseas Territory (country or jurisdiction property), filtered to public-sector classes, read 22 November 2026. Community-sourced: used as corroboration and for bodies the constitution orders don't name; each website was requested once on the same day and its HTTP status recorded (403 usually means the site blocks automated requests, not that it is closed). A body found only in Wikidata counts as current only when its website answers at the recorded address without redirecting elsewhere (site_confirms); and when the page's title isn't an error page (site_title is recorded; some sites answer a retired address with an error page and a success status).
